messages:
liam: quick Q — trying to find logs for 5xxs filtered by org=acme, model=redwood-v1, route=/generate in eu region. Where's the saved query? 🤔

devon: there's a dashboard but no canonical saved query yet. use Logsearch Discover: https://logs.internal.redwood.ai/app/discover#/

devon: try this query in the Discover bar:
```kql
org:"acme" AND model:"redwood-v1" AND route:"/generate" AND region:"eu" AND status:[500 TO 599]
```

maya: fyi also filter by `request_type:streamed` if you want streaming-related failures — otherwise results include transient infra 500s

anita: can you create a saved search and name it `acme-redwood-v1-generate-eu-5xx`? we should pin it to the eng-sre dashboard and add owner + runbook link

liam: yep can do, will add a short description and tags (owner:liam, infra:sre)

devon: also open a ticket to tune the alert threshold — current alert noisy for transient spikes. recommendation: aggregate over 5m and alert if 5xx ratio >= 3% on p50 qps

maya: ping @sre-oncall for alert tuning

sre-oncall: will take a look tomorrow morning, sounds reasonable. can you include the exact saved search id and a link to the dashboard panels in the PR?

liam: created saved search: https://logs.internal.redwood.ai/saved/acme-redwood-v1-generate-eu-5xx — added description, owner, and tags

devon: awesome — can you also add a short runbook section (what to check: GPU OOM, model fallback, region capacity)? just 3 bullet points

liam: done. runbook added to the saved search meta and linked in the alert PR

opsbot: NOTE: saved search `acme-redwood-v1-generate-eu-5xx` created by liam at 1768457001

maya: cheers — closing loop. I'll update the alert policy PR with the 5m aggregation and 3% threshold and mark as ready for review

liam: thanks all :thumbsup:
